key_facts: ophthalmoscopic examination revealed a yellowish oval lesion
wide area of chorioretinal atrophy is present
infrared examination showed a ringlike low reflectance pattern
spectral-domain optical coherence tomography revealed a focal scleral ectasia
sclera is approximately one-third thinner at the pit's floor, temporal wall, and nasal wall
pit has a homogeneous low autofluorescence
fluorescein angiography showed a branch of a posterior ciliary artery near the lesion
pit is slightly hyperfluorescent in the late frames
